why: Cycle 10 of the expression area (docs/v3/cycles/expression-10.md) ran six native cases that had never run, again with no referenced case because TuffUI published nothing after `f31ea2b`. Round-0 median 81.5, minimum 75, four cases passing at once (n39, n42, n43, n44) and the other two in round 1; on the F and K items the median was 85.5, the best of ten cycles. No P1 and one P2 (n41's BarList of request kinds that cannot join an hourly chart stacked by model). It met every convergence clause it could measure; the clause of three of four referenced verdicts cannot be met while no referenced case exists. 31 of 63 lost points were `primitive`, 30 `skill` and 2 `rubric`, so for the first time the kit cost more than the method. Repair rounds lifted the median by 2.5, so hypothesis 1 met its kill clause for the second cycle running, while the two repaired cases rose 7 to 9 points. Its fix rows (v3-expr-10-contract, v3-expr-10-kit-fixes, v3-expr-10-skill, v3-expr-10-rubric) add, behind a Spec, a BarList row that joins a chart's focus across grains, a Heatmap that takes the page's focus, mono on a BarList label and a ChartCard plot height at 390; fix twelve kit behaviours (labels at 390, end labels, empty and error states, the dark variant under auto, the pinned column surface, DataPanel sizing and phone cards, band-axis zones, zero stacks, clamped bars, phone-card focus gaps, held spans, the shot tool's focus state); make the fact count and the one-view check bite in the skill; and give F7 and X4 one reading for an x focus on a line chart. This cycle measures again on six cases that have never run. docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md is the protocol; it specialises docs/v3/CYCLES.md.

change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n45, n46, n47, n48, n49 and n50 (all native; none has run; n51 stays for cycle 12). Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `f31ea2b` (2026-11-16; cycles 7 to 10 found none); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-6/ref-shot.ts` in the main checkout shoots a page at 1440x1000 with reduced motion), and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 10 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-10/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools are in the same directory). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard frame, the list frame and the pointer sweep of cycle 10's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md; for hypothesis 1, report the per-case lift of the cases that were repaired beside the median lift, as cycle 10 does. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 10: (a) check v3-expr-10-kit-fixes before round 0 on a build of the pinned master: n39, n40, n41, n42 and n44 at 390 (the run, Today, peak and zone labels), n40's and n42's end labels, n39's, n42's and n44's `?shot-state=empty` footers, n40's and n43's `?shot-state=error` stat cards, n41 in dark with no `data-theme` and a dark system scheme, n42's entity column in light, n43's table panel and phone cards, n41's zone edges and a zero hour under the keys, n44 `?fixture=cloudburst`, n42's phone-card sweep, n39's held night band, and `basalt-ui shot --states focus` at 1800; also re-check cycle 9's two open gaps (a table inside a `DataPanel` loses its header in empty and error; n38's 390 loading card is 18 px taller than rest); if any did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (b) check v3-expr-10-contract: tell reviewers what the Spec ruled and which fields shipped (BarList cross-grain focus, Heatmap focus, BarList mono, a ChartCard phone height); (c) check v3-expr-10-rubric: if its sentence landed, the reviewer reads it from rubric.md; if not, tell reviewers the two readings of an x focus on a line chart that the cycle-10 file records (n39, n42); (d) run `make check-fast` on the round-0 tree before round 1 starts, never while a builder edits; (e) keep cycle 10's reviewer notes on the two sanctioned colour forms (a `light-dark()` pair in the series file is one), the 61 px band, the LIST approach and the shipped series-row, mono, stacked BarList, Sparkline readout, bar value and `focusItems` fields; (f) keep the builder prompt's line to look at the page the way the skill's last step says, without naming the keys state, and count who shot a keyboard frame (cycle 10: 6 of 6 in round 0); (g) `demo/series.ts` is shared: tell builders to change only their own group with one Edit after a fresh Read and never to rewrite the file, and to run `bun test` on its own; (h) once this cycle runs, the bank's only never-run cases are n51 and the ones it adds: add at least five from pages no case covers yet, so cycle 12 can draw six, and say so; (i) report every score on all items and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone; (j) the lead tool takes a chart's own HTML rows and a table's or list's rows that carry `data-chart-mark` for sweep marks (cycle 10: n42's and n43's sweeps moved between rows): read each LIST and SWEEP line against its frame and tell the reviewer what it hovered; (k) the lead tool's keyboard frame presses two keys from the first item, so on an hourly chart beside a list of nights or windows it never reaches an item a row holds, and no frame showed n39's chart-to-table direction: add a keyboard step or a sweep into an item a list row holds, so X3's chart-to-list direction has a frame; (l) cycle 10 met every convergence clause it could measure, and the referenced clause cannot be met while no `c` case can run: if this cycle meets the measurable clauses again, say so in the convergence section, and if the owner has ruled on the question by then, apply the ruling.
